_readme: Model fallback ladder, newest to oldest. Free tiers 503 on whatever just
launched because everyone is hammering it; older models are quieter.
VERIFY THESE IDS AGAINST CURRENT PROVIDER DOCS BEFORE THE FIRST RUN.
They were written from an assistant's training data, which is not the
present. An ID that no longer exists returns 404, which the generator
correctly treats as non-retryable and skips - so a stale ladder degrades
to 'every model failed' rather than anything subtle. Still, check them.
